name: BAJIC
author: Worz
description: Go above the teleport portal as the wave at 11%. Hit the far end of the portal to go into 1X speed (REQUIRED). Play through the wave challenge until 27% where you can stay at the ceiling until around 72%, where you should hold to the floor. Release at around 91.3%-91.4% to re-enter the level. Play the level normally from there.
